newsitem.title: UK: Wine tasters takes the shine off your teeth.
newsitem.headline: Wine tasters takes the shine off your teeth.

text.p: Wine buffs who swirl choice vintages around their taste buds could end up with rotting teeth, dentists have warned.
The British Dental Association issued the warning after examining a 52-year-old wine merchant whose teeth were so eroded that his fillings were protruding.
Acid in the wine had eaten away at the enamel in his teeth during a 40-year career when he tasted an average of 30 wines a days.
Swirling wine around the mouth before you spit it out doesn't help because this also soaks the teeth in acid.
Dentists urged wine buffs to clean their teeth twice a day without fail and make regular visits to the surgery.
